correctness.rationale: A permutation does not change rank and each constant a∘g corresponds to exactly one nonempty kernel fiber, yielding n! times the n-th-power sum. The binomial inequality proves each new higher part outweighs all possible smaller contributions; the greedy recovery and injectivity follow. The m=2 mass balance, monotonic \(h_n(m)\), and h_n(3) estimate yield the exact sharp gap. The abstract isomorphism consequence is explicitly conditional on Tsyaputa Theorem 2. The executable independently enumerates 29 full-map count profiles, 11 marked permutation profiles, and 43819 partition inversions up to n=32; none is asserted to replace proof.

value.rationale: The full kernel-class partition completely determines full-transformation variant isomorphism, but rank alone does not. A one-scalar count of a natural mixed rank-one product event captures the entire partition. Its O(n log n)-bit size, exact greedy inverse and optimal gap give a uniform quantitative reconstruction theorem for every finite size, rather than a substitution or fixed-size count.
